## Objetivo
Implement authenticated game CRUD and the collection/detail UI using the shared design system. Add a games migration and owner references; create deterministic local colored placeholders without network assets. Do not introduce play/history tables before T05.

## Critérios de Aceitação
- [ ] HTTP tests cover list/detail/create/update/delete, signed-out rejection, member ownership, trimmed nonempty titles, integer min/max players and duration, complexity 1 through 5, unknown IDs and minimum greater than maximum. Extend the T08 private-route authorization matrix for game routes. SQL uses parameters and foreign keys; deleting an unplayed game works. The played-game guard is completed with play references in T05.
- [ ] Collection cards and game detail show title, owner, player range, play time and complexity with stable generated placeholders. Add/edit/delete flows update the displayed canonical collection. Empty collection and failed validation include a clear next action and preserve entered fields.
- [ ] Fast tests cover placeholder determinism and API validation. Browser coverage at both viewports adds and edits a game, confirms changed metadata, captures collection/detail and visible validation-error states and asserts labeled controls and no horizontal overflow. npm test, typecheck and build remain green.
